title: An old explanation finds a precise limit

captions.energy: Ending a version that is exhausted
captions.emotions: Feeling fairness in a fresh conclusion

meaning: A methodical examination can make your shared view more precise by ending an exhausted version and acknowledging a proportionate conclusion.
text: An earlier explanation can sometimes end once its limit becomes precise. The Emperor in the physical position of Ajna suggests organising the foundations of a shared view and separating observations from a habitual conclusion. Death in energy supports constructive willingness to finish an exhausted account and move towards another understanding. Justice in emotions responds with a sense of fair proportion. There is pleasure in seeing reconsideration fit its material. The earlier answer can retain a place within experience while a new observation changes its application to the present question.

For example, you have explained successful outings together through thorough preparation. Examining several cases reveals memorable spontaneous walks where your interests simply coincided. **A precise limit allows an old answer to end without devaluing experience.** Preparation helped under some conditions while covering only part of the explanation. Particular circumstances can now be compared. Fairness comes through acknowledging both sides: the earlier thought had substance, yet it need not determine every conclusion about what makes shared time interesting.

The difficulty is demanding a final verdict on the past: either the rule was correct or everything rested on a mistake. Ending then stretches into another hearing. Willingness to release an exhausted version can preserve a more accurate scale. Seeing where the account no longer helps may suffice. Other experiences do not need one uniform assessment for a new view to become fair and meaningful.
